s: Tzeda haasura vehammutteret beshabbat ubo k"h seipim: tzeda hi meabot melakot shehayeta bammishkan battechashim vechillazon. Veeno chayyab aleha ella kesheen hannitztzod mechussar od tzeda achar tzeda zo, dehaynu shetztzad oto lemaqom sheyyukelu letopso sham beqal veeno tzarik lomar "habe metzuda unetzudennu", dehaynu sheeno tzarik lebaqqesh sham tachbulot letopso. Lepikak, im hipriach et haop ad shehikniso lebayit shechallonotayv setumin, o lebebar meqoreh vesatum mikkol tzad, venaal haddelet bepanayv, o sheradap achar chayya ad shehiknisah lebayit, o lebebar apillu eno meqoreh, o leginna o lechatzer, venaal bepaneha — chayyab, ubilbad shello yehe habbayit o habbebar gadol kol kak beinyan shetztzarik lebaqqesh tachbulot litpos sham haop o hachayya. Vekol shehabbayit o habbebar gadol kol kak sheeno yakol lehaggia velitpos hachayya o haop bimrutza achat, mippene shennishmatin mimmennu, vetzarik larutz acharehem shenit — hare hen mechussarin tzeda adayin, upatur. Vehatztzad tzippor deror, dehaynu min tzippor sheddarka ladur babbayit kemo bassadeh, sheyyodaat lehishshamet bezavit habbayit lekol tzad (ulekak niqra "deror" al shem dira, sheddara bekol maqom) — eno chayyab ad sheyyaprichenna lemigdal shehi nitztzoda bo, dehaynu lemigdal sheeno gadol meod, ella hu beinyan sheyyukal letopso sham beli tachbulot. Vehatztzad ari — eno chayyab ad sheyyaknisennu lakkippa shello shehu neesar bah. Vekol hatztzad lemaqom shehannitztzod mechussar sham tzeda adayin, ap al pi shehu patur — asur middibre soperim. Vehatztzad mimmaqom shehu mechussar tzeda sham — chayyab. Umimmaqom sheeno mechussar tzeda — muttar latzud lekattechilla beyom tob, abal lo beshabbat, mishshum issur tiltul. Veyesh oserim gam mishshum issur tzeda middibre soperim:

Hatztzad dabar sheeno mechussar tzeda, kegon shetztzad tzebi chigger o zaqen, o choleh mechamat ayeput, shehu yagea veeno yakol lazuz mimmeqomo — patur, abal asur middibre soperim. Abal hatztzad tzebi yashen o suma, o choleh mechamat chom shennolad lo begupo — chayyab, mippene shehem asuyim lehishshamet keshemmargishim yad adam, umechussere tzeda hen:
Hamshasseh keleb achar chayya kede sheyyatzud oto — patur, abal asur middibre soperim. Veap bechol asur latzud biklabim, mishshum "moshab letzim", veeno zokeh lirot besimchat livyatan:

En issur tzeda min hattora ella bedabar sheyyesh bemino nitztzod, dehaynu shedderek haolam latzud min zeh shetztzad hu, kegon mine chayyot veopot vedagim, shedderek haolam latzud minim ellu. Abal im tzad dabar sheen bemino nitztzod, kegon tzerain uzebubim veyattushim vekayyotze baellu, sheen derek haolam latzud minim ellu mippene sheen bahem tzorek, ap al pi shehu tzad otam letzorek — patur, abal asur middibre soperim apillu letzudan shello letzorek ella kemitasseq beolma. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello lisgor teba o listom keli sheyyesh bah zebubim, shehare hem nitztzodim bistima usegira zo. Veap sheeno mitkavven kelal letzeda, mikkol maqom "pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu. Ella yitten sakkin o shum dabar ben hakkissuy lakkeli beinyan sheyyukelu latzet mishsham, velo yihyeh "pesiq resheh". Veyesh meqillin bemaqom sheim yiptach hakkeli littelem mishsham yibrechu, shennimtza sheen kan tzeda kelal bekissuy zeh. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem leinyan sheen tzarik ledaqdeq uleayyen im yesh sham zebubim. Veap im roeh bevadday sheyyesh zebubim, mapriach mah shennireh leenayv vedayyo, veeno tzarik lechappes shemma nisharu od zebubim, shekkevan shehaddabar sapeq im yeshnan sham — en kan "pesiq resheh":

Muttar lipros machatzelet al gabbe kavveret shel deborim, bachamma mippene hachamma, ubaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim, ubilbad shello yitkavven latzud haddeborim. Vegam sheyyehe beinyan sheeno mukrach sheyyihyu nitztzodim bazeh, kegon shennishar bekavveret chor sheeno mekusseh bemachatzelet veepshar lahem latzet derek sham. Vaapillu hu chor qatan umin hatztzad sheeno nireh laddeborim — en bekak kelum, kevan shehu eno mitkavven latzud, veen kan "pesiq resheh", kevan sheepshar sheyyetzeu derek hachor qatan zeh shemmin hatztzad, veen haddabar mukrach shello yetzeu bo. Abal im en sham chor sheeno mekusseh bemachatzelet — asur, di"pesiq resheh" hu. Veap sheyyesh meqillin bizbubim bemaqom sheim yiptach hakkeli littelem mishsham yibrechu, mikkol maqom kan niqra tzeda gemura mah shehaddeborim nitztzodim bekavveret shello yukelu latzet mimmenna, ap al pi shehu lo yukal littelem mishsham beyadayv, mippene shehakkavveret hi meqom tzedatan, sheddarkan lihyot bekavveret, vahare zeh domeh letzad ari vehikniso bakkippa shello, sheap sheeno yakol littelo mishsham beyadayv shello yibrach — chayyab, mippene shezzehu meqom tzedato:

Happores metzuda ubishat perisato niknesa chayya letokah — chayyab. Abal im niknesa achar kak letokah — patur, mippene shebbishat perisato eno yadua im yatzud im lav, abal asur middibre soperim. Ulepikak, asur lehaamid beshabbat hammetzuda latzud bah akbarim:

Tzebi shenniknas lebayit meelayv, venaal echad haddelet bepanayv, apillu lo nealah beminal ella sheggippepah bilbad, vehu beinyan shehatztzebi shamur bekak shello yukal libroach — chayyab, mippene shezzehu tzedato. Naalu shenayim — peturim, shekkol melaka sheyyakol echad laasotah vaasauha shenayim — peturim, mippene shello naaset kedarkah bechol, sheen derek kelal laasot bishnayim mah sheepshar laasot beechad. Veim en echad yakol linol bilbaddo, venaalu shenayim — chayyabim. Veim echad yakol linol bilbaddo veechad eno yakol, venaalu shenehem — hayyakol chayyab, vesheeno yakol patur, mippene sheeno ella mesayyea lehayyakol, umesayyea en bo mammash. Veken haddin bekol melakot shabbat:

Im haya happetach meguppap kebar bedelet achar shenniknas hatztzebi labbayit, ben shennitgappepa haddelet meeleha, ben sheabar acher vegippepah — muttar linol bemanul. Shekkevan shehatztzebi hu kebar shamur shello yukal libroach, hare kebar nitztzod veomed hu, ukeshennoalo bemanul, ap al pi shemmosip shemira al shemirato — eno ella keshomero min haggannabim, veen bazeh mishshum tzeda:

Tzebi shenniknas labbayit veyashab echad al happetach umillea(v)hu, dehaynu shello nishar beno limzuzat happetach maqom panuy kol kak bikde sheyyukal hatztzebi libroach derek sham — hare zeh chayyab. Umuttar leadam acher lesheb betziddo shel zeh beoto maqom panuy shebbeno lehammezuza, ap al pi shemmosip shemira al shemirato shel rishon. Vaapillu amad harishon vehalak lo venistalleq shemirato, veen hatztzebi nishmar ella mechamat yeshibat hashsheni, shehammaqom panuy shebbeno lehammezuza, dehaynu maqom yeshibat harishon, en bo kede berichat hatztzebi — ap al pi ken en hashsheni tzarik laqum, umuttar lo lesheb ad shettechshak velittol hatztzebi, shekkevan shebbeshaa sheyyashab behetter yashab, shehare hatztzebi haya nitztzod veomed kebar al yede yeshibat harishon — en mechayyebin oto lehistalleq leachar sheamad harishon, mippene sheeno oseh kelum akshav bishiba zo, sheeno ella shomer latztzebi hannitztzod kebar al yede harishon. Vaapillu lekattechilla yakol lesheb betzad harishon al daat sheyyishshaer yosheb sham leachar sheyyaamod harishon veyelek lo:

Veken mi shehaya lo tzebi qashur bebeto, uba echad venaal gam haddelet bepanayv kede lehosip shemira al shemirato, veachar kak nittar hatztzebi — en mechayyebim oto liptoach haddelet, kevan shebbeshaa shennaal behetter naal, veakshav eno oseh kelum. Veken mi shennaal beto leshomro velo haya yodea kelal shenniknas tzebi labbayit, veachar kak noda lo — muttar lo lehaamid happetach naul ad shettechshak bemitkavven kede littol hatztzebi, lepi shekkeshennaal behetter naal, kevan shello haya yodea kelum, veakshav shennoda lo eno oseh kelum. Abal im yodea shetztzebi babbayit — asur lenoolo, apillu eno mitkavven kelal latzud hatztzebi ella lishmor beto, di"pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu:

Veken mi sheyyashab al happetach velo haya yodea shetztzebi betok habbayit, veachar kak noda lo — muttar lo lesheb sham ad shettechshak, sheakshav eno oseh kelum. Veken mi shenniknesa lo tzippor tachat kanpe kesuto, vehi nitztzoda sham meeleha — en tzarik liptoach lah challon, ella yosheb umeshammerah ad shettechshak:
Muttar liptoach habbayit bipne hatztzebi kede sheyyibrach veyetze. Veken tzebi shenniknas limtzuda — muttar leporqo mimmetzudato, ubilbad shello yetaltelennu:

Shechita hi meabot melakot, shehayeta bammishkan beelim utechashim. Velo shechita bilbad, ella kol hannotel neshama leechad mikkol mine chayya behema veop vedag vesheretz, ben bishchita, ben binchira, ben behakkaa — chayyab. Hachoneq et hachay ad sheyyamut — hare zeh toledet shochet. Lepikak, im natal dag min sepel shel mayim vehinnicho ad shemmet — chayyab mishshum choneq. Velo ad sheyyamut mammash, ella kevan sheyyabesh bo kesela ben senappirayv — chayyab, ap al pi shehecheziro lammayim achar kak, mippene sheshshub eno yakol lichyot. Velo ad sheyyabesh mammash, ella apillu keshennogein sham beetzba zab rir mishsham venimshak min haetzba. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello lomar lenokri lehotzi dag min hechabit shel mayim, ap al pi sheyyare sheyyamut sham. Vekol zeh benotel haddag mimmaqom shehaya nitztzod veomed sham, veeno mechussar tzeda kelal, kegon sepel vechabit (ayyen siman ttz"z). Abal im netalo mimmaqom shehaya mechussar tzeda sham, kegon nahar o bereka, apillu hecheziro miyyad lammayim shebbakkeli — chayyab mishshum tzeda. Vaapillu lo tepaso beyado kelal, ella sheshshala oto mehannahar betok sepel shel mayim — chayyab mishshum tzeda, shehare keshehu betok hassepel eno mechussar tzeda kelal:

Netilat neshama shechayyabin aleha, lo ad sheyyittol kol nishmat hachay, ella apillu natal miqtzat neshama — chayyab. Kegon hammotzi dam meechad meebere hachay — chayyab mishshum netilat neshama shebbeoto maqom, "ki haddam hu hannepesh":

Velo ad sheyyetze dam mammash, ella apillu hachobel beechad meebere hachay ad shennitzrar haddam tachat haor, ap al pi shello yatza lachutz — chayyab, lepi shehi chabbura sheenah chozeret, shekkevan shennitzrar haddam tachat haor — shub lo yukal lachazor limqomo, ella shehaor meakkebo atta millatzet lachutz, vechayyab mishshum netilat haddam shebbeoto maqom. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechobel baadam, o babbehema vechayya, o baopot, o bishmona sheratzim haamurim battora (beparashat shemini) shehem "hacholed vehaakbar vego'", shekkol echad meellu yesh lo or hamakkeb al haddam millatzet. Abal hachobel bishar sheqatzim uremasim — eno chayyab ad sheyyetze mehen dam. Abal im nitzrar haddam velo yatza — hare zeh chabbura hachozeret, sheilmale neeqar haddam mimmeqomo haya yotze lachutz, kevan sheen lo or hamakkebo:

Kebar nitbaer besiman ra"ch sheyyesh omerim sheen issur min hattora ella bimlaka hatztzerika legupah, dehaynu shetztzarik legup haddabar shehammelaka naaset bo. Lepikak, hannotel neshama — eno chayyab ella im ken tzarik legup hachay shehanneshama nittela mimmennu, o leoro, o shetztzarik lehanneshama shennittela mimmennu, dehaynu laddam hayyotze mimmennu, litteno lipne kalbo, o shechobel baadam shehu oyebo, vechapetz hu bedam hayyotze mimmennu, sheyyireh neqama beoyebayv (ayyen choshen mishpat siman tk"d). Abal hahoreg nachash bishbil shello yazziqennu — hare zo melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, kevan sheeno tzarik lo legup hannachash velo ledamo, veeno horego ella kede lehinnatzel mehezzeqo. Veken hatztzad eno chayyab ella im ken yesh lo tzorek begup dabar hannitztzod atzmo. Umikkol maqom, hatztzad mine chayya opot vedagim bistam — chayyab, shessetam tzedatan hi letzorek gupan o oran. Veken shemona sheratzim haamurim battora, hatztzad echad mehen bistam — chayyab, shessetam tzedatan hu letzorek oran, velo bishbil lehinnatzel mehezzeqan, shehare en darkan lehazziq. Abal hatztzad echad mishshear sheqatzim uremasim — eno chayyab ella im ken tzadan letzorek, kegon lirpua vekayyotze bah. Abal im tzadan bistam — patur, shessetam tzedatan enah ella bishbil lehinnatzel mehezzeqan, sheddarkan lehazziq, velo bishbil tzorek oran, shehare en lahem or, velo bishbil tzorek gupan, shehare eno rauy laakila, usetamo eno omed lirpua ella im ken mitkavven lekak beperush, veim ken hare zeh melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, kevan sheen lo tzorek bedabar hannitztzod atzmo sheggup hammelaka naaset bo:

Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar latzud kol mine remasim sheddarkan lehazziq, kegon nechashim veaqrabbim vekayyotze bahem, apillu bimqomot sheenan memitin binshikatan. Vaapillu en ratzin atta acharayv kelal, ella shechoshesh al heatid shemma yarutzu acharayv o achar adam acher vinashshekuhu, o shemma lo yishmor atzmo mehem vinashshekuhu, o shemma yazziqu laacherim shello yedeu lehishshamer mehem, shekkevan sheeno tzadan ella bishbil lehinnatzel mehezzeqan — hare zeh melaka sheenah tzerika legupah. Veap shekkol melaka sheenah tzerika legupah patur abal asur middibre soperim — kan hittiru chakamim legamre mippene chashash hezzeq haggup. Veap lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyab aleha, veen mechallelin shabbat bimlaka gemura shel tora bishbil hezzeq haggup, ella bishbil sakkanat nepashot, mikkol maqom, kan kevan sheeno tzadan kedarko, ella mitasseq bahem shello yukelu lehazziq, shekkopeh alehen keli o maqqip alehen o qosheran kede shello yazziqu, lepikak hittiru laasot ken apillu birmasim sheenan memitin kelal ella shemmazziqin bilbad:

Vekol zeh birmasim sheddarkan lehazziq mammash, kegon nechashim veaqrabbim, ap bimqomot sheenan memitin binshikatan, al kol panim hen mazziqin haggup binshikatan, veken kol kayyotze bahen. Abal kol sheeno mazziq haggup ella shemmetzaaro bilbad, kegon tzira uzebub veyattushin uparoshin vekayyotze bahen — asur letzudan. Velaken asur litpos parosh sheal begadayv, apillu hu mibbipnim samuk labbasar. Vaapillu hu al besaro veeno oqetzo adayin —asur letopso. Abal im hu oqetzo kebar — muttar littelo bishat aqitzato ulehashliko, shekkeshennotelo bishat aqitzato eno kemitkavven letzeda, ella kemitasseq bo shello yaaqtzennu, velo gazeru bazeh apillu bimqom tzaar bilbad, kevan shehu dabar sheen bemino nitztzod. Vegam lo gazeru bimqom tzaar al issur tiltul happarosh, ap al pi shehu muqtzeh. Veken im oqatzto tzira vekayyotze bah — muttar littelah beyado ulehashlikah, im i epshar lehaprichah. Veyesh mattirin latzud happarosh apillu meal begadayv mibbipnim, kevan sheyyukal letzaaro sham. Vaapillu meal chaluqo mibbachutz muttar letzudo, kevan shehechaluq hu samuk labbasar, veepshar sheyyabo happarosh mishsham labbasar veyaaqtzennu. Abal im happarosh hu al haadam beoto inyan sheen lachush sheyyaaqtzennu, shehu al beged haelyon mibbachutz — asur letopso sham, abal muttar lehappilo mealayv al yede niur. Uleinyan halaka, im epshar lo beqallut lehappilo mealayv beli netila beyad — yesh laasot ken, apillu im hu al chaluqo mibbipnim. Abal im hu labush bebatte shoqayim veqasheh lo lehappil happarosh im lo yittelennu beyad techilla, hassomek al hammeqillin bedibre soperim — lo hipsid:

Vekol zeh leinyan tzedat happarosh, abal leharego asur ledibre hakkol, apillu hu al besaro veoqetzo, shemmishshum tzaar beolma lo hittiru ella tzedato, lepi sheen bemino nitztzod, velaken en tzeda zo chashuba melaka kelal, abal harigato hi melaka gemura, ella sheeno tzarik legupo, veyesh omerim sheppatur aleha, mikkol maqom asura middibre soperim, velo hittiruha mishshum tzaar beolma, hoil veiqqarah min hattora, dehaynu im tzarik legupah. Vaapillu lemolelo beetzbeotayv lehattish kocho shello yachazor elayv — asur, gezera shemma yahargennu, ella yittelennu beyado veyizreqennu:

En chayyabin mishshum netilat neshama ella al mine baale chayyim shehem parim verabim venehevin mizzakar uneqeba. Abal remasim hannehevin min haggelalim umin happerot shehibishu vekayyotze bahen, kegon tolaim shel basar vekattolaim shebbetok haqqitnit, hahoregan — patur, mippene shebbammishkan lo hayeta netilat neshama ella beelim utechashim vechillazon shehem parim verabim venehevin mizzakar uneqeba. Umikkol maqom, happarosh yesh bo mishshum netilat neshama, ap al pi shehaviyyato min heapar veeno pareh verabeh, lepi shekkol hammithavveh min heapar — chayyut yesh bo keillu pareh verabeh mizzakar uneqeba, ki techillat beriyyat baale chayyim hayeta min heapar, kemo shekkatub "vayyomer elohim totze haaretz vego'". Veezehu parosh? Zo hi shechora haqqopetzet. Abal lebana harocheshet — hi hanniqret "kinna", umuttar leharegah beshabbat, mippene shehi min hazzea. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemotze kinna al besaro, o shemmetzaah al begadayv derek miqreh. Abal hampalleh begadayv mikkinnim — molelan beetzbeotayv vezoreqan (apillu lemayim), abal asur leharegan beyadayv, shekkevan shemmepalleh begadayv — chosheshin shemma yimtza gam ken paroshim veyahargem gam ken. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimpalleh begadayv. Abal bimpalleh rosho — muttar laharog hakkinnim beyadayv, mippene sheen paroshim metzuyin barosh:
Lo yiqqach adam hakkinnim meorot shualim vekayyotze bahem, mishshum shehu menatteq sear min haor, veyesh bazeh mishshum gozez. Veap al pi sheeno mitkavven lekak, "pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu:

Kol chayya veremes shehen noshekin umemitin vadday, kegon nechashim hasserapim vekeleb shoteh vekol kayyotze bahem mehammazziqin shekkeshennoshekin hen memitin bevadday — muttar leharegam beshabbat apillu enan ratzin acharayv kelal, mippene sheyyesh piqquach nepesh baharigatan, ki shemma yamitu shum adam miyyisrael. Vekol sepeq nepashot docheh et hashshabbat, apillu bimlaka gemura shel tora, ap lehaomerim sheapillu melaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyabim aleha min hattora. Ushear mazziqin, apillu otan shebbevadday en memitin binshikatan ella shemmazziqin et haggup bilbad, kegon nechashim veaqrabbim bimqomot sheen memitin leolam binshikatan ella shemmazziqin bilbad, veken kol kayyotze bahem — yesh omerim sheim hem ratzim acharayv muttar leharegam, lehaomerim shekkol melaka sheenah tzerika legupah enah asura ella middibre soperim, lepi shebbimqom hezzeq haggup lo gazeru. Veeno domeh leparosh haoqetz besaro sheasur leharego, shehapparosh eno mazziq haggup ella metzaaro bilbad. Veim enan ratzin atta acharayv, ella shechoshesh al heatid — asur leharegam hariga hannikkeret shehi naaset bemitkavven, abal muttar ledorsam lepi tummo bahalikato. Vaapillu bemitkavven kede laharog, ella shemmareh atzmo keillu holek lo lepi tummo veeno mekavven kelal laharog, shekkevan shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah enah asura ella middibre soperim — lo gazeru aleha kelal bimqom hezzeq haggup, apillu en sham ella chashash beolma, ella shebbazeh hitzriku leshannot baharigatan bekol mah deepshar leshannot, dehaynu leharot atzmo keillu eno mekavven leharegam. Vaapillu mine chayya veremes sheyyesh binshikatan sepeq nepashot, shellipamim hen memitin velipamim en memitin — tzarik leshannot baharigatan, kol sheenan ratzin acharayv. Abal mine remasim sheenan mazziqin, kegon nemalim vekayyotze bahem — asur ledorsam apillu eno mitkavven leharegam ella shehu "pesiq resheh". Vetzarik ledaqdeq behilluko bimqomot shehem metzuyim. Ulehaomerim sheapillu melaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyabim aleha — lo hittiru laharog kesheratzin acharayv, velidros lepi tummo kesheen ratzin acharayv, ella bemine chayya veremes sheyyesh binshikatam sepeq nepashot. Abal dabar sheeno memit leolam binshikato — asur apillu ledorso, vaapillu ratz acharayv, sheen mechallelim shabbat bimlaka gemura shel tora bishbil hezzeq haggup. Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, kol baal nepesh yesh lo lehachamir al atzmo beissur shel tora bemaqom sheepshar, dehaynu im en ratz acharayv — al yidresennu, im epshar lo lehishshamer mimmennu ulehazhir laacherim sheyyishshameru mimmennu:

Otan haanashim shehoregin beshabbat hassemamit (sheqqorin shpy"n) — tzarik limchot beyadam, shehare enah mazzeqet. Veap sheyyesh lachush shettippol letok hammaakal, mikkol maqom dabar sheeno matzuy hu, vegam epshar lekassot hammaakalim, vegam achat meelep hi mesukkenet bemaakal. Vegam im haya bah chashash sakkana — lo hittiru ella lidros lepi tummo:

Chayya veop haggedelim birshuto shel adam, kegon mi shemmegaddel tzebayim bebeto o bachatzero, o avvazim vetarnegolim veyonim, hatztzadan beshabbat — patur, shehare nitztzodin veomedin hen. Abal hatztzad yone shobak veyone aliyya — chayyab, shemmechussarin tzeda hen, shekkesheadam ba littelan miqqinnehen — hen asuyin lehishshamet velibroach miqqinnehen. Mah sheen ken opot haggedelim babbayit, shekkeshehen bain likluban baereb noach letopsan sham, mippene sheaz enan asuyin lehishshamet velibroach, ulepikak ap keshehen chutz likluban enan niqraim mechussarim tzeda, kevan shellaereb yabou likluban mealehen. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim asur letzudan, dehaynu lirdop acharehen ad sheyyikkanesu lemaqom shennoach letopsan sham. Abal letaltelan beyad asur belo issur tzeda, mishshum muqtzeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen bechatzer o bayit gadol kol kak sheim lo gadelu ben bene adam hayu tzerikim metzuda, dehaynu lebaqqesh tachbulot letopsam sham, vehayu niqraim mechussarim tzeda, kegon shehu bayit gadol kol kak sheeno yakol letopso sham bimrutza achat, verodep sham acharehem ad sheyyikkanesu lecheder sheeno gadol kol kak venoel haddelet bipnehem. Abal im hem bebayit sheeno gadol kol kak — nitztzodin veomedin hen. O apillu hen bebayit gadol kol kak, vaapillu hen birshut harabbim, vedocheh otam ad sheyyikkanesu lebayit acher gadol kol kak — en kan tzeda kelal, umuttar:

Vekol zeh bechayya veop, abal behemot haggedelim birshuto shel adam — muttar letzudan, apillu mereshut harabbim. Vechatul — dino kishar chayya, veasur letzudo ella al derek shennitbaer. Vekol zeh beshello maredu, abal im maredu, apillu para shemmorda, veen tzarik lomar chayya veop shemmaredu, hatztzadan beshabbat — chayyab, kemo hatztzad chayyot veopot habbar, shehare hallalu gam ken lo yabou likluban laereb:
